PLANNING COMMISSION  Chair  Gen Escobosa
REGULAR MEETING  Vice Chair  Erik Peña
  Commissioner  VACANT
Notice of Cancellation  Commissioner  Roman Rodriguez
  Commissioner  Stephany Gonzalez
September 25, 2024, 7:00 PM

  NOTICE OF MEETING
  CANCELLATION

  OF THE FOLLOWING:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PLANNING COMMISION

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regularly scheduled meeting
of the Planning Commission of the City of Baldwin Park scheduled for
Wednesday, September 25, 2024, has been CANCELLED due to lack
of quorum.

  Said meeting was to be held in the Council Chambers,
  14403 E. Pacific Ave., Baldwin Park CA, at 7:00 pm.

  The Next Regular Meeting of the Planning Commission will be
  held on Wednesday, October 9, 2024

  Dated this 25th day of September 2024

  Nick Baldwin
  Planning Commission Secretary
